g.text: Exact restoration: every bounded fault plus legal command returns the correctly updated canonical spike code.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #343c41

g.text: Coordinate edit: one fixed mask must replace one factor while preserving the other, in every canonical donor/recipient case.
